The Great Learning

Quotes / The Great Learning / Q0152

English

The way of great learning lies in illuminating luminous virtue, in renewing the people, and in resting in the highest good.
Thinker The Great Learning
School Confucianism
Source Liji, The Great Learning
Theme Virtue
Another quotation More from this thinker

Context and commentary are editorial aids for reading. They do not replace the primary text or scholarly commentary.

Source context

This English passage is associated with Liji, The Great Learning, within the tradition of Confucianism. The wording below is a verified rendering prepared for careful reading rather than a claim of unique translation authority.

A short reading

Read in the register of virtue, the sentence asks the reader to test an assumption rather than to collect a slogan. In The Great Learning's wider work, similar claims are usually offered as prompts for judgment: what would have to be true for the sentence to hold, and what would follow if it did?
